summary: Completed phases 1-3 of the 15-phase corpus-consolidation plan and committed each separately. Phase 1 landed the standing corpus-size probe (script-inventory.sh --size-line, wired into verify-deploy.sh's summary, no new gate row) and captured the baseline (232 scripts/90,568 lines; 160 suites/76,832 lines). Phase 2 mechanically derived per-cluster net-deletion figures and declared targets of -700 lines (production) and -1,200-line floor (test), both below the illustrative guesses in the already-answered Prior Decision -- reported honestly rather than inflated to match. Phase 3 extracted lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh and migrated the two smallest lint-cluster members onto it, with a 10-case regression test and confirmed byte-identical whole-corpus finding output; net is +93 lines in isolation, justified in the plan as the precondition for Phase 5's larger extraction (consistent with the plan's own net-positive-justification policy, not reverted). 12 phases remain (4-15); Phase 4, or any of the Wave-3 siblings 9/10/11, is the next unblocked work.
